bootstrap.method: circular block bootstrap of the book's daily return path
bootstrap.seed_rule: seed_i = SEED + 7919*i, owned by the resample index: independent of --procs and --shard (r1349; the first version seeded per job, so the percentiles moved with the worker count)
bootstrap.frozen: constants written before the first run; the gate refuses a face that echoes others
